nodes.asset_description: Centered illustration panel showing a wide coupe glass filled with a frosty pink strawberry daiquiri on a pedestal stem. A fresh strawberry with seeds and green leaves is perched on the rim at the upper-left of the glass. The glass has soft watercolor-style shading and small sparkling bubbles. Behind the glass is a pink checkerboard backdrop made of alternating light and mid pink scalloped squares. Below the glass, the floor forms sunburst rays in diagonal wedges of peach-orange and pink. The entire illustration sits within a soft pink rectangular panel with subtle inner shadow.

nodes.svg_description: Large bordered information panel with 2 px #1b1a1b stroke. Inside, a thin horizontal rule near the top and another below the rule, with a centered swatch bar made of six adjacent small rectangles: #f6d7c9, #f7c3c7, #f7a9bb, #f38ea8, #e06a8b, #b01f3b. A long horizontal divider splits the upper paragraph area from the lower two-column area. In the lower section, a single vertical line divides the left and right columns.

nodes.text: The Daiquiri, the classic cocktail from which the Strawberry Daiquiri is derived, was invented in the early 20th century in Cuba by American engineer Jennings Cox. It was named after Daiquiri beach near Santiago de Cuba. The original Daiquiri was a simple mix of rum, lime, and sugar.
2 oz White Rum | 1 oz Fresh Lime Juice | 1/2 oz Simple Syrup | 1/2 cup Fresh Strawberries | 1 cup Crushed Ice
